FX-KALEIDO-001.says: The settings as they start: 6 segments, Mirror, rotation 0, size 100, the centre in the middle: the wedge from straight up through 60 degrees clockwise is the drawing's own, and it is repeated round, every other copy mirrored.

FX-KALEIDO-002.says: 2 segments, Mirror: the right half is the drawing's own and the left half its mirror image.

FX-KALEIDO-003.says: 2 segments, Repeat: the right half is the drawing's own and the left half the right half turned half round the centre.

FX-KALEIDO-004.says: 6 segments, Repeat: FX-KALEIDO-001's first wedge, every copy turned the same way.

FX-KALEIDO-005.says: Rotation 30: the wedge from 30 degrees through 90 is the drawing's own.

FX-KALEIDO-006.says: Size 200: the pattern twice as large, read from half as far out.

FX-KALEIDO-007.says: Size 50: the pattern half as large, reaching past the drawing, where it reads the drawing mirrored back at its edges.

FX-KALEIDO-008.says: The centre at 25 per cent across, 50 down.

FX-KALEIDO-010.says: Rotation keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 60 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is FX-KALEIDO-001 and frame 2, rotation 30, FX-KALEIDO-005.

FX-KALEIDO-011.says: Size keyed from 100 at frame 0 to 1000 at frame 4, eased past its end: frame 2 would pass 1000, is held at 1000, and is size 1000.

FX-KALEIDO-012.says: FX-KALEIDO-001 moved three pixels right: the pattern moves with the drawing and the three columns left bare stay empty.

FX-KALEIDO-013.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the centre and the wedge are the drawing's own, not the grown buffer's, and the pattern reads the tiles round it.

FX-KALEIDO-014.says: Segments 1, below 2. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KALEIDO-015.says: Segments 33, above 32. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KALEIDO-016.says: Size 9, below 10. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KALEIDO-017.says: Centre across 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KALEIDO-018.says: Rotation 3601, above 3600. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KALEIDO-019.says: A mode "flower", which is not one. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-KALEIDO-020.says: Size keyed to 1001 at frame 4, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
